relationships.subject: supradural CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP induced robust periorbital mechanical allodynia selectively in females

relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: bath application of CGRP₈₋₃₇ significantly reduced firing in females, eliminating the difference between sexes, whereas no significant effect was observed in males

relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP₈₋₃₇ reduced EPSC amplitude in females but not males

key_findings: Supradural CGRP produced female-selective periorbital allodynia, bilateral hindpaw hypersensitivity, and avoidance-like behavior in both sexes.
CeA neurons from CGRP-exposed females showed higher excitability and larger PB-evoked EPSCs, reduced by CGRP8-37.
